projectDescription: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that gives AI assistants searchable access to the LEMON and CHARM self-hosted car repair manual archives, covering ~305,000 vehicles from 1960–2025.
keyFeatures: Vehicle search across ~305,000 vehicles from the LEMON (1960–2025) and CHARM (1982–2013) repair-manual databases
Full-text search (FTS5) over manual titles and body content with lazy or pre-built indexing
Fetch and convert repair manual pages to clean Markdown via the get_page tool
Retrieve validated in-manual images as MCP image blocks via the get_image tool
Opaque encoded path tokens ensure safe, round-trip navigation across all tools
Stateless Streamable HTTP MCP transport — compatible with any MCP-capable AI client
Applicability filtering: filter search results by whether content applies to a specific vehicle year
Deduplication of search results across duplicate tree placements in the manual archive
publicApiSurface: MCP tool: list_makes — list all car makes with vehicle counts and year ranges
MCP tool: search_vehicles(query, limit) — free-text vehicle search returning drivetrain-grouped results
MCP tool: get_page(path, depth, max_bytes) — fetch a manual page or directory listing as Markdown
MCP tool: search_manual(path, query, mode, limit, applicable_only) — FTS5 search within a vehicle manual
MCP tool: get_image(path) — fetch an image from a manual page as an MCP image block
HTTP endpoint: POST /mcp — Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint
